_note: The farm animals' refined pixel art (AnimalArt; the dog held in the arms too, PlaceholderArt._beast). The same light as the figures (data/villager_art.json): every material in three tones, shade / base / lit, lit from the upper left (a part's upper-left side lit, its lower-right side shade), the edge of a part laid over another material in the part's own deep tone, and a rim round the silhouette in the deep tone of the material it touches pulled towards `rim` by `rim_mix` instead of the old near-black outline. The tones are the villagers' numbers so the animals stand in the figures' light; the rim is pulled less (0.4 against 0.6) because the animals' pixels are half the size and the pale hens and sheep should keep a soft grey edge, not a black one. `sick` dulls the body, head and leg colours towards a grey (legs a little less) and darkens them. Colours are ours (Japanese Black cattle, cream wool with dark faces, a red-tan shiba with a cream chest, white hens with red combs, yellow chicks).

carrying._note: A carrying cow or ewe (sprite kind + data/animals.json breeding.sprite_suffix): a rounder belly hung under the body, centre (bx + rx * belly[0], by + ry * belly[1]), radii (rx * belly[2], ry * belly[3]), in the body's tones (a ewe in wool gets curls of wool_curl art pixels); three to five art pixels lower than the plain belly, between the legs. A cow's udder is fuller (udder_grow added to its radii) and hangs at the new belly line. Same canvas, poses and facings; our own design.
